shortdesc.ph: Used to configure media stream relay across channels.
Used to configure cross-channel media stream relay.
Configuration of cross channel media relay.

plentry.pd:
Information of the source channel. See . This struct includes the following members:
channelName: Name of the source channel. Default is , indicating the SDK uses the current channel name.
token: Token used to join the source channel, generated from channelName and uid.
If you have not enabled App Certificate, set this parameter to the default value , indicating the SDK uses the App ID.
If you have enabled App Certificate, you must use a Token generated from channelName and uid, and uid must be set to 0.
uid: Unique user ID used to identify the relay stream in the source channel. It is recommended to keep the default value of 0.

pd.note: If the Token of any destination channel expires, the entire media stream relay will stop. It is recommended to set the same Token expiration time for all destination channels.
pd.ph: Information of the destination channels. See . This struct includes the following members:

ul.li: channelName: Name of the destination channel.

token: Token used to join the destination channel, generated from channelName and uid.
If you have not enabled App Certificate, set this parameter to the default value , indicating the SDK uses the App ID.
If you have enabled App Certificate, you must use a Token generated from channelName and uid.

uid: Unique user ID used to identify the relay stream in the destination channel. The value range is 0 to (2^32 - 1). To avoid user ID conflicts, this ID must differ from other users in the destination channel. Default is 0, indicating the SDK will generate a random UID. See .

plentry.pd: Number of destination channels. Default is 0. Value range is [0, 6]. Make sure this value matches the number of structs defined in destInfos.
Media information of the source channel. See .
Collection of media information for destination channels. The key is the channel name, and the value is the corresponding media information. See .

pd.p:
The information of the source channel. See . It contains the following members:
channelName: The name of the source channel. The default value is , which means the SDK applies the name of the current channel.
token: The token for joining the source channel. This token is generated with the channelName and uid you set in srcInfo.
If you have not enabled the App Certificate, set this parameter as the default value , which means the SDK applies the App ID.
If you have enabled the App Certificate, you must use the token generated with the channelName and uid, and the uid must be set as 0.
uid: The unique user ID to identify the relay stream in the source channel. Agora recommends leaving the default value of 0 unchanged.

The information of the target channel . It contains the following members:
channelName: The name of the target channel.
token: The token for joining the target channel. It is generated with the channelName and uid you set in destInfos.
If you have not enabled the App Certificate, set this parameter as the default value , which means the SDK applies the App ID.
If you have enabled the App Certificate, you must use the token generated with the channelName and uid.
If the token of any target channel expires, the whole media relay stops; hence Agora recommends that you specify the same expiration time for the tokens of all the target channels.
uid: The unique user ID to identify the relay stream in the target channel. The value ranges from 0 to (2 32-1). To avoid user ID conflicts, this user ID must be different from any other user ID in the target channel. The default value is 0, which means the SDK generates a random UID.

plentry.pd: The number of target channels. The default value is 0, and the value range is from 0 to 6. Ensure that the value of this parameter corresponds to the number of structs you define in destInfo.
